title: AgentFlow — API
description: af-api server spans: traffic, errors and latency.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, if(`attribute_string_http$$route` != '', `attribute_string_http$$route`, name) AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND kind = 2 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND kind = 2 AND toUInt16OrZero(response_status_code) >= 500 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, 100 * countIf(has_error) / count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND kind = 2 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, quantile(0.5)(duration_nano) / 1e6 AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND kind = 2 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, quantile(0.95)(duration_nano) / 1e6 AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND kind = 2 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, quantile(0.99)(duration_nano) / 1e6 AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND kind = 2 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT if(`attribute_string_http$$route` != '', `attribute_string_http$$route`, name) AS route, count() AS calls, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_nano) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND kind = 2 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY route ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 20

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT name, status_message, count() AS errors FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'af-api' AND kind = 2 AND has_error = true AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY name, status_message ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 20
